summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of ELASTECH landing (dynamic contact form) and admin panel. 14/14 pytest cases pass. All Playwright UI flows pass: wrong password stays on login, correct login redirects to /admin, dashboard stat cards render, contact form submits from landing and clears (record appears in admin list), empty submit triggers validation, row click opens detail drawer and decrements unread counter, delete removes submission, missing token on /admin redirects to /admin/login.

issues: Non-critical console warning from Lenis: 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position...' — cosmetic only.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger is defined at line 231 but referenced inside seed_admin (called from startup event registered before logger is defined at module import time). Currently works because module-level code runs top-to-bottom before startup fires, but reordering (define logger near top) would be safer.

CORS_ORIGINS='*' combined with allow_credentials=True is invalid per CORS spec — browsers reject credentialed requests with wildcard origin. Not an issue today since admin uses Bearer token (no cookies), but should be tightened to explicit origins before enabling httpOnly cookie auth.
POST /api/contact returns 200 instead of the more conventional 201 Created. Minor REST hygiene issue.
No rate limiting / brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (playbook mentions lockout after 5 fails). Consider adding for production.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed submissions and clean up the lifecycle-scoped one via DELETE. A couple of TEST_ submissions (TEST_User, TEST_Playwright) may remain in DB from create-only tests; safe to leave or purge.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_elastech.py and cover contact CRUD + auth + admin protected endpoints. Uses BASE_URL from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Admin JWT stored in localStorage key elastech_admin_token. All data-testid selectors documented in the review request are wired correctly.
